description: Evaluation CLI for multi-turn RAG benchmark systems

validate.description: Check whether a prediction file is well-formed for a given evaluation mode

arguments.--input: Path to input task JSONL file
arguments.--predictions: Path to prediction JSONL file to validate
arguments.--mode: Evaluation mode: retrieval_taska, generation_taskb, or rag_taskc

validate.behavior: Exit 0 if the prediction file is valid for the specified mode; non-zero with diagnostics otherwise

evaluate.description: Score system predictions against relevance judgments and reference answers

arguments.--input: Path to input task JSONL file
arguments.--qrels-dir: Directory containing per-domain relevance judgment files
arguments.--output: Path to write JSON evaluation results

rank.description: Produce a system leaderboard from evaluation result files

arguments.--results-dir: Directory containing *.json evaluation result files (system name = file stem)

rank.output_format: CSV sorted descending by harmonic_mean with columns: rank, system, nDCG@5, Recall@5, ROUGE-L_F1, harmonic_mean

compare.description: Paired statistical significance testing between two evaluated systems

arguments.--result-a: Path to system A evaluation JSON (contains per_query scores)
arguments.--result-b: Path to system B evaluation JSON (contains per_query scores)
arguments.--output: Path to write JSON comparison results

compare.notes: Results must be deterministic for a given seed.
